title: Gli altri racconti di Canterbury
writer: Pietro Aretino, Sabadino Degli Arienti, Giovanni Boccaccio
actors: Enza Sbordone, Antonio De Leo, Francesco D'Adda
plot: The comic erotic misadventures of pilgrims comprised of young widows, buxom servants, newlywed brides and eager peasants while they travel from Canterbury to London to visit the tomb of Thomas Becket.
